references.text: Sin lies in wait at the door and seeks to rule over man - sin finds a way
Judah acknowledges that God has found their wrongdoing - sin is exposed
The Lord warns that He will punish the people for their sin on the day of visitation
The consequences of sin against the Lord and the promise that wrongdoing will be repaid
Warning to be careful to do what the Lord has commanded
Achan's sin was discovered and had consequences for all Israel
Disobedience to the Lord is like the sin of witchcraft
Job acknowledges that God makes him aware of his wrongdoings and sins
The heavens reveal the wrongdoing of the wicked
Our transgressions are many before God's sight, and our sins testify against us
Your evil will punish you, and your apostasies will rebuke you
The Lord remembers their wrongdoing and punishes their sins
Whoever sows to their flesh will reap corruption from the flesh
All things are naked and exposed before His eyes, to whom we must give an account
